docs.title: About Minirogue Build Logic
docs.text: This project is my own personal Gradle convention plugins. Note that they do not follow all recommended practices for larger teams.

docs.title: Dependencies
docs.text:
This repo manages several dependencies (namely ones that have related gradle plugins) that will be inherited by any projects that consume it. As of version 0.3.3 the following dependencies and versions are used:

  • Android Gradle Plugin (AGP) = 9.2.1
  • ComposeMultiplatform = 1.11.1
  • Detekt = 2.0.0-alpha.5
  • HotReload = 1.2.0
  • Java = 21
  • Kotlin = 2.4.10
  • Kotlin Serialization = 1.11.0
  • Kotlin Symbol Processing = 2.3.9
  • Metro = 1.4.1
  • Room = 2.8.4

Minimum supported Gradle version: 9.4.1 Latest tested Gradle version: 9.5.0
